issues.description: The problem statement specifies a milking method `messageOnMilk(double milkVolume)` and a return format containing the volume, but the UML diagram and the provided code (template Main and solution interface/implementations) define and call `messageOnMilk()` with no parameters. This makes it unclear which method signature students should implement and which one the tests will expect.
issues.suggestedFix: Choose one contract and apply it consistently across problem statement, UML, template, and solution. Either (A) change the problem statement to require `String messageOnMilk()` and remove the volume from the specified output, or (B) change UML + template + solution to `String messageOnMilk(double milkVolume)` and update Main and all implementations to pass/print the volume exactly as specified.
